Storage is managed automatically: old programmes are removed every day, logos are capped, and the database is compacted when needed.

Saves your Plex servers (with their access tokens), channel and category choices, favourites and settings to a file. Copy it with a file manager app to keep it somewhere else. The file isn\'t encrypted, so keep it private.
Only the categories you tick are downloaded, so lists load faster and use less storage.

On. Film and series pages show “More like this” from TMDB.

With your own TMDB key, film and series pages show “More like this”: similar titles that TMDB suggests. To get a free key, sign in at themoviedb.org, then go to Settings › API. When you use “More like this”, MyPlexPlayer sends the title that you opened to TMDB.
“More like this” for films and series. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
